summaries.Good news: Today's uplifting stories celebrate resilience and wonder: a 31-year-old cat thriving on spring water, a rescued lynx experiencing grass for the first time, and NASA's Curiosity rover discovering breathtaking honeycomb landscapes on Mars.
summaries.Ideas: The day's ideas explore how AI is reshaping enterprise value, democracy, workplace culture, and human connection—from sneaker design philosophy to the importance of life outside work.
summaries.Technology: Major breakthroughs span from discreet medical wearables to right-to-repair diagnostics tools, AI voice assistants becoming domesticated, and ambitious architectural visions emerging from nature-inspired design.
summaries.Design: Today's design highlights showcase innovative approaches to acoustics and music spaces, customizable skincare formulation, sustainable material innovation, and elegant solutions for everyday problems.

items.title: Acoustics shape design of copper-clad concert hall in Evian
items.snippet: French studio PCA-Stream has completed La Source Vive, a domed copper-clad concert hall in Évian, France, designed "as a musical instrument". items.line: Designing buildings as musical instruments—using acoustic principles to shape form—represents a fundamental shift in how architecture can serve human experience and art.

items.snippet: While everyone needs technology of one sort or another, certain people shrink from any stigma associated with it. items.title: Astronomers Have Detected an Exomoon for the First Time
items.snippet: A discovery in a solar system 73 light-years from Earth is challenging definitions and “blurring the lines between stars, planets, and moons.”
items.line: Detecting the first exomoon challenges our fundamental understanding of celestial mechanics and expands the diversity of worlds we know could exist.
